approvedBy: User explicitly requested designs 1 and 2 replace all original skins
prompt:
Design a remarkable but entirely buildable desktop web app screen for “LifeAtlas / 生活全图”, full-bleed landscape 16:10, high-resolution crisp Simplified Chinese, no device/browser/mockup frame. A private personal-growth tool where someone compares their earlier understanding with their present understanding. This must clearly read as a working app rather than an editorial poster.

Direction “对页观察室”: refined warm porcelain-white, charcoal ink, muted mineral blue, and a small restrained burnt-orange action accent. A compact charcoal horizontal navigation header creates an anchor above an expansive quiet white comparison workspace. Elegant editorial Chinese headings with very readable neutral sans body text. The signature is a beautifully balanced two-period comparison, generous typographic hierarchy and finely ruled rows, not decorative paper, literal book binding or equal dashboard tiles. Outside the opaque white reading area, distant almost-invisible cool particles add a calm, slightly futuristic living atmosphere.

Organize the screen around a two-column comparison of one growth topic, with clear period selectors above the columns and aligned first-person sections. A small topic selector and situation summary sit to the left of the main comparison, and one grounded next-experiment row bridges the bottom. Show the entire app shell, clear active view, natural content density and feasible standard controls.

Brand “LifeAtlas / 生活全图”. Header navigation “今日”, “邮箱整理”, “个人成长” selected, “任务记录”, “偏好设置”; avatar and subtle particle toggle. Main heading “慢慢看清，自己怎样改变。” Topic “工作与生活的边界”. Tabs “变化过程”, “前后对照” selected. Left period “2025.10.17”, label “当时的记录”: “临时接到任务，我取消了与家人的约定。”; “当时的理解”: “我以为，可靠就是随时答应。” Right period “2026.10.17”, label “后来的经历”: “先问截止时间，约定周一交付，保留了周末。”; “现在的理解”: “可靠，也可以包含清楚表达自己的安排。” Bottom “下一次尝试” and “回应前停一下，先看自己的日历。” Actions “记录经历”, “阶段总结”, “查看修改历史”. Small visible “设计示例”. Distinguish earlier and later through quiet type and spacing, never red/green judgment, progress scores, streaks, AI claims or invented improvement statistics. Prioritize elegant reading and a distinctive usable composition.
role: UI composition reference; UI text/controls must be semantic; decorative lake is separate generated asset; no invented photos, counts, account avatars or capabilities
